zh.text: 清华大学是位于北京市海淀区清华园的公立综合性大学，始建于1911年。其校址原为清代皇家园林，校园地处北京西北郊。学校设有涵盖理学、工学、人文、法学、医学、经济学、管理学及艺术等领域的多个学院与系部。作为教育部直属高校，清华大学在学科设置上兼顾基础研究与应用科学。

en.text: Tsinghua University is a public comprehensive university located in Haidian, Beijing, China. Founded in 1911, the campus is situated in the former imperial gardens of the Qing dynasty in northwest Beijing. The institution is affiliated with the Ministry of Education and operates under the Double First-Class Construction initiative. Its academic structure includes schools and departments spanning science, engineering, humanities, law, medicine, economics, management, and art. The university maintains a broad range of faculties to support diverse fields of study.
